2608.02352.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
2608.02352.paper_summary: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.
2608.02352.paper_summary_zh: 本地計算機使用為代理提供了一個通用界面，使其能夠操作幾乎所有可供人們使用的軟件，但這需要長期的狀態跟踪、大規模的互動經驗以及從稀疏但可驗證的結果中學習。我們介紹了 Qwen-CUA，一個擁有 397B-A17B Qwen 混合專家骨幹的本地計算機使用代理。它僅觀察截圖，並通過鍵盤和鼠標事件進行操作，無需 DOM 樹、可訪問性元數據或特定任務的 API。它的支架最多可維持 20 個活躍的截圖，並將較舊的視覺歷史折疊成固定大小的區塊，以保留最近的證據，同時保留可重用的提示前綴。為了進行訓練，我們建立了一個雲端推出艦隊，擁有近 100,000 個 vCPU 和數萬個並發環境，構建了大約 40,000 個可驗證的任務，並收集了日常和專業軟件的個性化長期工作流程。我們用可驗證的獎勵和軌跡切片來優化完整的軌跡，而迭代訓練運行則刷新監督數據並重新校準強化學習任務。在八個基準測試中，Qwen-CUA 超越了 Qwen3.7，並在與領先的專有系統競爭中保持競爭力，在 OSWorld-Verified 上達到 86.2，在 OSWorld 2.0 上達到 18.5/48.4 的二元/部分完成度。將相同的配方擴展到一個擁有超過一萬億參數的模型，產生了 Qwen-CUA-Max，將這些分數提高到 87.6 和 21.2/53.3。Qwen-CUA 還將 RedTeamCUA 攻擊成功率從 36.6 降低到 16.4，相對於 Qwen3.7。效率分析、瀏覽器部署和增強 Bash 的實驗進一步特徵化了實際行為。這些結果確立了本地計算機使用作為一個廣泛能力的代理基礎，並突出了可擴展的可驗證互動和混合工具使用作為關鍵方向。
